_doc: HubSpot contact property changes that become Aurum conversion events. property = the contact property the webhook subscription watches. eventName = one of Lead, Qualified_Lead, SV_Scheduled, SV_Done, Booking, Disqualified. when = only fire if the new value is one of these (case-insensitive); omit to fire on any change. valueProperty = contact property sent as the deal value (use for Booking).
